findings.title: Preserve the account UI interpolation syntax
findings.body: This resource is consumed by the account UI, which uses `{{...}}` interpolation (as in other messages in this file). Changing the placeholders to Java `MessageFormat` syntax means the UI will not substitute the attribute name or limits, and it will display the `{2,choice,...}` expression literally in the multivalued-size validation error.

findings.title: Preserve the admin UI interpolation syntax
findings.body: The admin UI uses `{{...}}` interpolation for resource messages. These single-brace placeholders and the Java `choice` expression are not interpreted by that client-side formatter, so this validation message will show literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and the choice expression instead of the attribute name and limits.

findings.title: Keep the Lithuanian TOTP instruction in Lithuanian
findings.body: This change replaces the Lithuanian instruction with Italian text (“Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare”). Lithuanian users will see an unrelated-language instruction when setting up TOTP.

findings.title: Keep the Lithuanian TOTP instruction in Lithuanian
findings.body: This change replaces the Lithuanian login instruction with Italian text (“Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare”). Lithuanian users will see an unrelated-language instruction while setting up TOTP.

findings.title: Use Simplified Chinese for the zh_CN resource
findings.body: This replacement is written in Traditional Chinese (for example, “手機” and “應用程式”), while this file is the Simplified Chinese `zh_CN` resource. Simplified Chinese users will receive a visibly inconsistent instruction.
